description: Header file defining the API for a vector of key-value pairs, including function declarations for initialization, addition, removal, retrieval, and validation of key-value data structures.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a key-value vector.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the vector.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair identified by key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Replace
methods.description: Replaces the value for a given key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_ReplaceWithHint
methods.description: Replaces the value for a key with an optional hint for optimization.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddUnsigned
methods.description: Adds a key with an unsigned integer value.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddBool
methods.description: Adds a key with a boolean value.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddDateTime
methods.description: Adds a key with a datetime value.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddEnum
methods.description: Adds a key with an enumerated value.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddHexNumber
methods.description: Adds a key with a hexadecimal number.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the key-value vector.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the vector, mainly for debugging.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_FindKey
methods.description: Finds the index of a key in the vector.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_ValidateArguments
methods.description: Validates the provided key-value arguments against an expected schema.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetUnsigned
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned integer value for a key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetUnsignedWithinRange
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned value within a specified range.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value for a key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetIntWithinRange
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value within a specified range.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a datetime value for a key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetHexNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a hexadecimal number for a key.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetEnum
methods.description: Retrieves an enumerated value for a key.
